results.name: Font Selection & Base Point Size (12pt)
results.details: Approved font [Times New Roman 12pt] configured with standard 12pt base size.
results.remediation: Ensure \documentclass[12pt,...]{report} and \usepackage{mathptmx} are present.

results.name: One-inch Margins on All Sides
results.details: Geometry defines uniform 1.0-inch margins (letterpaper, top=1in, bottom=1in, left=1in, right=1in).
results.remediation: Use: \usepackage[letterpaper, top=1in, bottom=1in, left=1in, right=1in]{geometry}

results.name: Page Number Distance (>= 0.5 in from edge)
results.details: Footskip explicitly set to 0.6in (>= 0.5 inches from paper edge).
results.remediation: Add: \setlength{\footskip}{0.6in} to LaTeX preamble.

results.name: Title Free of Abbreviations (Rubric Sec I.C)
results.details: Dissertation title ('COMPUTATIONAL EVALUATION OF EPIGENETIC CLOCKS AND TRANSCRIPT...') contains no forbidden abbreviations.
results.remediation: Expand all acronyms in the dissertation title into their full spelling (e.g., Alzheimer's Disease instead of AD).

results.name: Double Spacing Throughout Manuscript
results.details: Setspace package configured with double spacing throughout document.
results.remediation: Ensure \usepackage{setspace} and \doublespacing are present.

results.name: Title Page Setup & Counter Initialization
results.details: Title page is appended as page 1 (unnumbered) and page counter correctly initialized to 2.
results.remediation: Title page must be counted as page i (unnumbered), with \setcounter{page}{2} for page ii.

results.name: Preliminary (Roman) and Body (Arabic) Pagination
results.details: Preliminary pages use roman numerals; main body switches to Arabic numerals at page 1.
results.remediation: Use \pagenumbering{roman} for preliminary pages and \pagenumbering{arabic} \setcounter{page}{1} at Chapter 1.

results.name: Chapter-Based Numbering Scheme (1.1, 2.1) Without Suffixes
results.details: Chapter-based numbering scheme (1.1, 2.1) enforced with no prohibited letter suffixes (e.g. 21a, 21b).
results.remediation: Ensure report documentclass is used and figure/table numbers do not use letter suffixes.

results.name: Citation Formatting Consistency (Square Brackets)
results.details: In-text citations consistently use square brackets ([1], [2-4]) without subscripts per Rubric Sec I.H.
results.remediation: Use biblatex with style=numeric-comp and natbib=true (no subscripts).

results.name: Copyright Page Formatting (Page ii)
results.details: Copyright page correctly formatted: year present, 'by' lowercased, 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED' all caps, no (c) symbol.
results.remediation:
Format copyright page: 'Copyright 20XX

by

Author Full Name

ALL RIGHTS RESERVED'

results.name: UCSF Publishing Agreement Included as Numbered Final Page
results.details: UCSF Publishing Agreement is included as the final page, omitted from TOC, and explicitly numbered via pagecommand.
results.remediation: Include publishing agreement at the very end with \includepdf[pages={1}, pagecommand={\thispagestyle{fancy}}]{publishing_agreement_signed.pdf} (omit from TOC).

results.name: Portrait Orientation & US Letter Paper
results.details: Standard portrait US Letter (8.5x11 in) single-column layout confirmed.
results.remediation: Ensure \documentclass has letterpaper option and single-column layout.

results.name: Widows and Orphans Prevention Penalties
results.details: TeX penalty parameters for widows and orphans (\clubpenalty, \widowpenalty) enforced.
results.remediation: Add: \clubpenalty=10000 \widowpenalty=10000 \displaywidowpenalty=10000 to preamble.

results.name: Abstract Placement, Double Spacing & ALL CAPS Heading
results.details: Abstract appears directly before TOC, is double-spaced, with title and student name in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS.
results.remediation: Place \chapter*{ABSTRACT} directly before \tableofcontents with \doublespacing and ALL CAPS title/name.

results.name: List of Abbreviations Component
results.details: List of Abbreviations section present.
results.remediation: Add \chapter*{LIST OF ABBREVIATIONS} before Chapter 1.

results.name: ProQuest ETD Submission Guidelines Checklist
results.details: Verified: (1) Committee members match Advance to Candidacy petition; (2) Keywords identified; (3) Degree date matches graduation term; (4) Dual UCSF & personal emails required in ProQuest.
results.remediation: Ensure ProQuest ETD metadata matches UCSF Registrar records exactly upon upload.

results.name: Sequential Ordering of Components
results.details: All 14 detected sections follow strict UCSF sequential order.
results.remediation: Ensure preliminary and body sections appear in exact order specified in Rubric Section II.A.

results.name: Heading Hierarchy & Styling (Primary/Secondary/Tertiary)
results.details: UCSF 4-level heading hierarchy (Primary Centered Bold Caps, Secondary Bold Left, Tertiary Italic) configured via titlesec.
results.remediation: Configure \titleformat for chapter, section, subsection, subsubsection per rubric Sec III.J.

results.name: Table Captions Placement (Above Table), Single Spacing & Bold Reference
results.details: Table captions configured above tables with bold labels and single spacing per Rubric Sec III.A.
results.remediation: Use: \captionsetup[table]{position=above, skip=6pt, font={small,singlespacing}} and labelfont=bf, and place \caption above \begin{tabular}.

results.name: Figure Captions Placement (Below Figure) & Single Spacing
results.details: Figure captions configured below figures with single spacing per Rubric Sec III.B.
results.remediation: Use: \captionsetup[figure]{position=below, skip=6pt, font={small,singlespacing}} and place \caption below \includegraphics.

results.name: Block Quotation Formatting (Single-spaced & Indented)
results.details: Block quotations configured with single spacing per Rubric Sec I.F & III.C.
results.remediation: Add \usepackage{etoolbox} \AtBeginEnvironment{quotation}{\singlespacing} to preamble.

results.name: Table of Contents (ALL CAPS Title & Prelim Exclusion)
results.details: TOC correctly configured with ALL CAPS heading, double spacing, and excludes preliminary sections.
results.remediation: Use \renewcommand{\contentsname}{TABLE OF CONTENTS} and unstarred \chapter*{} for prelims.

results.name: List of Figures & Tables (Separate Pages & ALL CAPS Title)
results.details: List of Figures and List of Tables configured with ALL CAPS headings on separate pages.
results.remediation: Use \renewcommand{\listfigurename}{LIST OF FIGURES} \renewcommand{\listtablename}{LIST OF TABLES} and separate with \clearpage.

results.name: References Section Formatting & TOC Entry
results.details: Unified References section titled 'REFERENCES' and registered into Table of Contents.
results.remediation: Ensure: \printbibliography[heading=bibintoc, title={REFERENCES}] is used.

results.name: Electronic Publishing PDF Specifications (No Security)
results.details: Compiled PDF has no password/security restrictions and is prepared for electronic publishing.
results.remediation: Ensure dissertation PDF is compiled without security encryption or password restrictions.

results.name: Compilation Log Quality (Zero Undefined Citations/Labels)
results.details: Clean compilation log: zero undefined citations, references, or fatal errors.
results.remediation: Check .bib resources and run biber to resolve missing citations.
